name: In Glorious Madness (Prayer)
body:
The gods of madness send you into a mad frenzy frightening those that oppose you.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Madness Domain

Benefit: You gain a +5 divine bonus to a single Intimidate check per day. If you have 10 or more ranks in Intimidate, the bonus increases to +10. If you use this bonus while making an Intimidating Glare rage power, your divine bonus increases by an additional +2.
